summary: Radar for 2026-10-15, focused on GLP-1. The best opening is a calm, sourced warning about gray-market 'reta' with a new peer-reviewed hook. A Penn study in JAMA Network Open (Oct 2026) used AI to read about 150,000 Reddit posts on unapproved retatrutide. The most common symptom people reported was increased appetite, not the stomach side effects seen in the trials. Medscape and Medical Xpress covered it on Oct 15, and it extends our best-performing Short (bootleg Reta, 128 views). Second is a named-drug comparison: Lilly's Foundayo (orforglipron) pill, FDA-approved Apr 1, 2026, against the Wegovy pill. ACHIEVE-3 tested it head-to-head against oral semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes, and Lilly now reports an indirect comparison against oral semaglutide 25 mg. The tirzepatide-muscle series is still the most reliable evergreen slot filler. The Oct 14 tirzepatide eye-disease coverage and the Annals NAION study (about 3-4 extra cases per 10,000 over 18 months) work best as one balanced 'GLP-1s and your eyes' piece. On its own, NAION is a scare topic that has done poorly for us. Verification notes: the Wegovy pill's EU approval was in July 2026, so it isn't new. The semaglutide asthma/COPD data are observational, from ERS. The tirzepatide retinopathy cohort was published in January 2026 and is only being covered again now. Rejected: rankings of online GLP-1 programs, compounded price indexes, and 'research' or patch products.

candidates.topic: AI read about 150,000 Reddit posts on gray-market retatrutide: the most common reported symptom was increased appetite, not the GI effects seen in trials (Penn, JAMA Netw Open, Oct 2026)
candidates.angle: What people online say 'reta' does vs what the trial drug did. Phase 2 side effects were mostly GI. Reddit users most often reported increased appetite, plus sleep problems and a faster heart rate. The researchers caution that users may not have been taking real retatrutide. Retatrutide is investigational as of Oct 2026, and Lilly plans to file in Q1 2027. Point viewers to a prescriber. Never name sellers.
candidates.why_now: Peer-reviewed JAMA Netw Open paper covered Oct 15 by Medical Xpress and Medscape. It lands right on top of the bootleg-Reta death-report coverage (CBS Oct 13, poison-center data) and the AJC black-market story (Oct 15). Our bootleg Reta Short is our best GLP-1 Short (128 views).

evidence.signal: About 150,000 posts and about 14,000 users describing use. Increased appetite was the most common symptom; researchers say to treat the findings with caution
13,589 users with a mapped symptom; the profile differs from the GI-dominated Phase 2 results

candidates.topic: Did orforglipron (Foundayo) beat the Wegovy pill? ACHIEVE-3 in type 2 diabetes: 9.2% vs 5.3% weight loss at 52 weeks (17.2 mg vs oral semaglutide 14 mg), plus Lilly's new indirect comparison vs oral semaglutide 25 mg
candidates.angle: The two GLP-1 pills explained side by side. Orforglipron is a non-peptide pill that can be taken any time of day without food or water restrictions; the semaglutide pill is a peptide tablet. Status: Foundayo FDA-approved Apr 1, 2026; Wegovy pill approved Dec 22, 2025.

candidates.topic: Does tirzepatide (Mounjaro) affect your eyes? Lower diabetic retinopathy risk vs lifestyle alone (Ophthalmology cohort, 86,923 per group), alongside the new Annals NAION data on semaglutide and tirzepatide
candidates.angle: A balanced 'GLP-1s and your eyes: what's known' piece. The large observational cohort linked tirzepatide to lower 12-month retinopathy risk (RR 0.705 for proliferative DR) in adults with diabetes and overweight/obesity. The separate Annals study linked GLP-1s to about 3-4 extra NAION cases per 10,000 over 18 months, with no causation shown. Practical close: keep your eye exams and report sudden vision changes promptly.
candidates.why_now: Medical Economics (Oct 14) covered tirzepatide and eye disease. ScienceDaily and Fox ran vision-loss stories on Oct 15, and Korean coverage of vision side effects is also out. People are searching for reassurance plus the facts, and a named tirzepatide title performs well for us.

evidence.signal: Tirzepatide and reduced risk of diabetic retinopathy: multicenter US cohort, 173,846 total (86,923 per group)
